definitions.explanation: The hosting or sponsoring of an event by two or more organizations working together. Each party shares responsibility for planning and execution.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{共催|きょうさい}だ。
examples.english: This event is co-hosted by two organizations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{共催|きょうさい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{講演会|こうえんかい}→講演会：15096_kouenkai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: The city and the university jointly held a lecture event.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧シンポジウム⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学会|がっかい}→学会：04139_gakkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{共催|きょうさい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}われ→行う：01238_okonau⟧、⟦{幅広|はばひろ}い→幅広い：11326_habahiroi⟧⟦テーマ→テーマ：17684_teema⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This year's symposium was co-organized by three academic societies and covered a wide range of topics.

notes:
{共催|きょうさい} means co-hosting or joint sponsorship — when two or more organizations share responsibility for organizing an event.

USAGE:
- Functions as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb and as a noun.
- Constantly appears on event flyers, programs, and official announcements alongside related sponsorship roles.
- The prefix {共|きょう}～ means 'together, joint': ⟦{共同|きょうどう}→共同：02591_kyoudou⟧ (joint, cooperative), ⟦{共有|きょうゆう}→共有：11666_kyouyuu⟧ (sharing).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- A⟦{社|しゃ}→〜社：04660_sha⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧B⟦{社|しゃ}→〜社：04660_sha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{共催|きょうさい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (companies A and B co-host)
- {共催|きょうさい}⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧: a co-hosted event
- ⟦{主催|しゅさい}→主催：11405_shusai⟧：A、{共催|きょうさい}：B、⟦{後援|こうえん}→後援：12616_kouen⟧：C: 'Organized by A, co-hosted by B, supported by C' (typical event-flyer credit line)
- ⟦{国際|こくさい}{会議|かいぎ}→国際会議：28601_kokusaikaigi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{共催|きょうさい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to co-host an international conference)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{主催|しゅさい}→主催：11405_shusai⟧: hosting/organizing (by a single primary organizer).
- ⟦{後援|こうえん}→後援：12616_kouen⟧: support/patronage (a less active backing role, often by a public agency).
- ⟦{協賛|きょうさん}→協賛：19226_kyousan⟧: sponsorship (typically financial support from a company).
- ⟦{協力|きょうりょく}→協力：00261_kyouryoku⟧: cooperation (the broadest, vaguest support credit).
